digest.component_or_area: agentic execution mode, prompt caching configuration
propositions: Tool-result history is re-sent uncached on every agentic turn, causing input cost to grow O(N^2) in turn count while only system and tool-definition breakpoints are cached

cache_settings_for sets only two of four available caching knobs (anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions) but omits anthropic_cache and anthropic_cache_messages, leaving the message tail uncached
warn_if_cache_ineffective telemetry cannot detect the message-tail caching inefficiency because the system block hits cache, making cache_read_tokens nonzero and masking the uncached history cost
Anthropic and Bedrock providers require different cache configuration keys (anthropic_cache vs bedrock_cache_messages); top-level cache_control causes Bedrock to reject the request
Single-turn execution paths must remain byte-identical after enabling message-tail caching on the agentic path to prevent regression
Multi-turn agentic runs demonstrate 7.9x more cache-read tokens and ~2.8x lower cost when message-tail caching is enabled, with fully-warm runs approaching 99.99% cache hit rate
